LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Spear.label: river spear
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Spear.description: A light spear with a socketed bronze head, carried by every levy that marches out when the flood is low.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Kalasiris.label: kalasiris
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Kalasiris.description: Weave fine linen into the long sheath dress worn in the heat of the river valley.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Irrigation.label: irrigation
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Irrigation.description: Dig shallow canals, carry the river's black silt onto the fields and let the water do the rest.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_CompositeBow.label: composite bow
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_CompositeBow.description: Glue horn, wood and sinew into a short, angled bow that shoots further than a plain stave.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Bread.label: date bread
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Bread.description: Bake round loaves of emmer and dates in clay moulds, with onions and soft cheese on the side.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_RiverSoil.label: gift of the river
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_RiverSoil.description:
Every field is measured after the flood and planted in the same week. Nothing grows by luck in Kemet.
Tradition: Colonists harvest 8% more from every plant.
Requires 15 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Scribes.label: house of scribes
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Scribes.description:
Children who can write are taught to write well, to count grain and to copy the old books without a single error.
Tradition: Colonists learn 7% faster.
Requires 15 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SunCalendar.label: sun calendar
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SunCalendar.description:
Three seasons of four months, read from the rising of one bright star. Sowing and reaping happen on the right day.
Tradition: Colonists sow and harvest 7% faster.
Requires 20 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Obelisk.label: obelisks
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Obelisk.description:
Quarry a single needle of stone, raise it with ramps and ropes and cap it with gold that catches the first light.
Requires 10 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.label: khopesh
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.description:
Forge the sickle-sword of the chariot corps, a blade that hooks shields aside and cuts like an axe.
Requires 10 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Papyrus.label: papyrus workshop
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Papyrus.description:
Split river reeds, lay them crosswise, beat them flat and dry them in the sun: the writing sheet of a whole civilisation.
Requires 15 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Stonemasons.label: royal stonemasons
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Stonemasons.description:
Copper saws, sand and patience. Kemetic masons dress a wall so smooth that a knife blade will not slide between the blocks.
Tradition: Colonists smooth stone 20% faster and mine 5% faster.
Requires 25 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ChariotCorps.label: chariot corps
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ChariotCorps.description:
The war crown of blue leather and the scale corselet of the charioteers, made to turn arrows on the move.
Requires 25 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ChildrenOfSun.label: children of the sun
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ChildrenOfSun.description:
Linen, shade at noon, water in the morning and a nap in the heat. Kemetians work where others faint.
Tradition: Colonists are comfortable in 5°C more heat.
Requires 25 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_RoyalKitchens.label: royal kitchens
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_RoyalKitchens.description:
Clean water, covered jars and cooks who wash their hands. The palace kitchens feed a thousand and poison no one.
Tradition: Meals cooked by colonists are 40% less likely to cause food poisoning and colonists cook 5% faster.
Requires 25 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Medjay.label: medjay patrols
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Medjay.description:
Desert scouts who run all day and shoot from the hip. They guard the tombs, the roads and the borders.
Tradition: Colonists move 2% faster and aim 5% faster.
Requires 35 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Senet.label: senet
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Senet.description:
A board of thirty squares, five pieces each and four throwing sticks. Kings were buried with their sets.
Requires 10 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DesertRifle.label: desert rifle
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DesertRifle.description:
A long rifle with a slim brass-bound stock, sighted for the open distances of the desert edge.
Requires 35 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_NileEngineering.label: river engineering
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_NileEngineering.description:
Dams, sluices and steam pumps. The old canals are rebuilt in iron and the flood answers to a timetable.
Tradition: Colonists build 5% faster and work 2% faster.
Requires 45 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SecondSunrise.label: second sunrise
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SecondSunrise.description:
With Iteru dug out of the sand, the kingdom remembers what it was and builds as if it had all the time in the world.
Tradition: Colonists harvest 4% more, build 5% faster and their mental break threshold drops by 2%.
Requires 50 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
Unlocked by finishing the nation's story.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ArcherPylon.label: archer pylon
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_ArcherPylon.description:
The temple gates become fortresses: archers on the pylons can cover the whole avenue of sphinxes.
Requires 40 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_PowderArms.label: Kemetic powder arms
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_PowderArms.description:
The New Kemet way of making a matchlock or a flintlock: the barrel, the lock, the stock and the drill to use them.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once New Kemet has reached the Age of Powder.
Requires 30 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SteamArmy.label: Kemetic steam army
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SteamArmy.description:
Cartridges, rifled barrels and a uniform: the army New Kemet raised when the factories came.
Outside your heritage, this can be researched only once New Kemet has reached the Age of Steam.
Requires 45 Kemetic knowledge unless this is your heritage.
